run_rl_training: run a batch reinforcement learning training script with a specified config and log directory
create_environment: create a wrapped OpenAI Gym environment with range normalization, action clipping, and 32-bit conversion
define_training_loop: define a training loop with separate train and eval phases using graph elements and step counts
train_agent: train a reinforcement learning agent by creating environments, simulation graph, and running the training loop
load_and_run_config: load or create a training configuration and launch the trainer with evaluation score logging
